svg.title: White Plaque: Bridge Arch and Reflection II
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and standardized vivid screen colour approximate. Two rounded white lobes meet at a shallow inward waist. The centre is painted white, not a hole. Cast shadows and gallery wall omitted; subtle surface seam simplified. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek1024-ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
